NextReleaseTracker.name: 追剧助手
NextReleaseTracker.description: Track only user-selected TV shows and movies, notify once when the next season or sequel appears, then finish tracking.
NextReleaseTracker.author: Codex

history.v1.1.7: Renamed the plugin's user-facing display name to 追剧助手 while keeping the stable plugin ID for compatibility.
history.v1.1.6: Clarified advanced manual movie mapping examples with real TMDB movie IDs and explicit movie-name references, so users can understand which numbers to fill in.
history.v1.1.5: Fixed audited backend gaps: invalid cron now falls back safely, notify-off scans keep unresolved releases pending instead of silently dropping them, and collection-based movie removals also clear manual mappings.
history.v1.1.4: Added a real config-page editor for advanced movie manual mappings, and kept that mapping text in sync with runtime changes.
history.v1.1.3: Refined config and status-page copy into simpler user-facing language, while keeping advanced manual ID and mapping controls available.
history.v1.1.2: Added time-sorted TV and movie candidate lists with title filtering and one-click whitelist selection, plus bootstrap seeding from local history for selected entries.
history.v1.1.1: Reworked the config and status UI around explicit whitelist selection, with visible selected lists, clearer tracking state, and direct remove actions.
history.v1.1.0: Switched to explicit watchlists: subscriptions are no longer tracked by default, scans notify once when a new season or sequel appears, and the track is then closed.
history.v1.0.2: Added safe runtime event diagnostics for TV completion handlers, with automatic cleanup and status-page visibility.
history.v1.0.1: TV-only default mode, refined plugin form and status page with action buttons, richer runtime visibility, and host delivery hardening.
history.v1.0.0: Initial delivery with TV next-season tracking, TMDB collection movie sequel tracking, manual management APIs, transfer-history backfill, and status page.
